title: Iterated list '…' is being modified inside for loop body, consider iterating through a copy of it instead.
summary: Emitted when items are added or removed to a list being iterated through. Doing so can result in unexpected behaviour, that is why it is preferred to use a copy of the list. pylint calls it modified-iterating-list.
message_templates: Iterated list '{}' is being modified inside for loop body, consider iterating through a copy of it instead.

title: Iterator '…' from an outer scope is reused or consumed in a nested loop.
summary: Used when an iterator defined in an outer loop scope is consumed in a nested loop. Because iterators are stateful and exhausted upon consumption, the inner loop will fully consume the iterator during the first iteration of the outer loop, leaving it empty for all subsequent iterations. pylint calls it looping-through-iterator.
message_templates: Iterator '{}' from an outer scope is reused or consumed in a nested loop.

title: Deprecated module ….
summary: A module marked as deprecated is imported. pylint calls it deprecated-module.

title: Using deprecated method …().
summary: The method is marked as deprecated and will be removed in the future. pylint calls it deprecated-method.

title: Using deprecated argument … of method …().
summary: The argument is marked as deprecated and will be removed in the future. pylint calls it deprecated-argument.

title: Using deprecated class … of module ….
summary: The class is marked as deprecated and will be removed in the future. pylint calls it deprecated-class.

title: Using deprecated decorator …().
summary: The decorator is marked as deprecated and will be removed in the future. pylint calls it deprecated-decorator.

title: Using deprecated attribute ….
summary: The attribute is marked as deprecated and will be removed in the future. pylint calls it deprecated-attribute.
